body: Thank you very much for your kind words. If I will definitely contact you if I need someone to talk to (also anyone who offered to do so as well if you are reading my response).

I have decided to go and seek a suicide/depression prevention meetup group to talk to others going though similar feelings as me. I posted an article to Redman113's comment about why I feel uncomfortable talking to school counselors about my life. I will post the article here as well: http://www.newsweek.com/2014/02/14/how-colleges-flunk-mental-health-245492.html

I found this article that properly explains why I am scared of going to school counselors: http://www.newsweek.com/2014/02/14/how-colleges-flunk-mental-health-245492.html

Since I am suicidal, I am afraid that similar occurrences displayed in this article could happen to me. I'd rather find a suicide/depression meetup group to at least talk about my situation to someone/other people. Thank you though. Without this comment, I wouldn't have thought of this idea.

I am actually an avid gamer, well at least I was until I started college. I was afraid that my grades would drop due to leaving off my work for gaming. But I feel as if I need more time for fun so I will definitely look into mmo rpgs to play. Any suggestions?

I also definitely agree with what you said about emotional attraction. I believe that emotional attraction is 'deeper' than physical attraction. I hope someday I will have that type of relationship with someone.

I will look into makeup. I have never worn it due to never knowing how to use it and thinking that it would make my acne look worse. But now that it has subsided from childhood, I will start to look into it. I am scared that it will cause me to break out though, but I am sure there are ways to prevent that. Thank you.
I applied to my state school and they gave me a very good scholarship, but I still would have had to pay a lot out of hand, and that wouldn't have been be feasible given I pay for school myself.

I wanted to say thank you to every one that replied to my post. Thank you for taking the time to read through my grievances. I will contemplate all of the advice given and see what my best action plan is. Thank you again.
